title: Chapter 223
text:
The sanctuary was a huge project, and it was always difficult to start from scratch. However, Coney Fury had its ways. The planning was very detailed, and the construction was done in an orderly manner. The division of work between each department was very detailed.

The main storyline of the sanctuary also caused a sensation on the forums. The expedition war was still brewing, and the sanctuary became the first big main storyline mission to appear. It immediately attracted the attention of the players. Furthermore, the first batch of players had tried it themselves, and the news was very reliable.

This was a large-scale main storyline, and they would only complain about the lack of people. The more people there were, the faster it would be completed.

Good lord! The Southern Continent instantly became lively. The players gathered their friends and headed to Sanctuary Three together. It became a huge gathering, and the number of players in the sanctuary increased like a snowball.

There were now a few hundred thousand players in Blue Star, and there were more than a hundred thousand in the Southern Continent alone. In just two days, more than twenty thousand players had come to Sanctuary Three through various channels. Han Xiao and the appeal of the main storyline had ignited the passion of the players.

The one thousand Dark Net members who followed them at the beginning were completely dumbfounded. Countless Inhumans came to help, and they were all called by Han Xiao. They felt like they were in a dream.

The influence was terrifying!

Because the Inhumans did not sleep or rest, and their work efficiency was equivalent to that of several people. These twenty thousand Inhumans were almost equivalent to seventy to eighty thousand workers, and by the looks of it, there would be more Inhumans coming.

It was not impossible to complete the prototype of the sanctuary in a month!

Realizing this possibility, the entire construction team was like they were on steroids, and they started construction with all their might.

If Sanctuary Three could be completed before Sanctuary One, it would be a huge contribution that would shock the organization!

In just three days, the camp had changed a lot. Simple houses were built, and the Dark Net members all had roofs to cover their heads.

Huang Yu paced outside Han Xiao's house for a long time before he finally made up his mind and knocked on the door.

Creak.

The door opened, and Han Xiao's figure appeared. He was wearing a mechanic's uniform and protective glasses.

"What's the matter?" Han Xiao's tone was calm.

Hearing this, Huang Yu suddenly felt uncertain. He smiled awkwardly and said, "Your Excellency, I …"

Without waiting for him to finish, Han Xiao turned around and went back into the house. "Come in and talk."

Huang Yu hurriedly entered the door. Seeing Han Xiao pointing at him, he found a place to sit down. With his butt close to the edge, he said with a fawning expression, "Your Excellency, I hope to share some of your responsibilities. After all, I am your assistant …"

As the number of players increased, Huang Yu realized that the one-month plan really had a chance to succeed. Once it succeeded, Sanctuary Three would be the first completed example. This contribution was not small at all. Even as an assistant, his name would be recorded in the Dark Net's merit book.

Huang Yu couldn't sit still anymore. If he missed out on the credit, he would regret it to death. Because of his previous perfunctory attitude, he felt that he had already offended Han Xiao, so he didn't assign any tasks to him. If Han Xiao complained to Bennett again, this credit would be completely lost to him. Originally, he was quite happy that he had nothing to do, but now he was anxious. He only wanted to join the construction as soon as possible. That was why this scene happened. He shamelessly went to Han Xiao's door to make up for his previous disrespect.

Han Xiao ignored him. Seeing Huang Yu sitting on pins and needles, he slowly said, "You don't want to do anything, right? I understand my subordinates and gave you a break. What are you not satisfied with?"

"What … what are you talking about? I am your assistant. I can also contribute my abilities." Huang Yu wiped his sweat with a sincere expression.

Han Xiao crossed his arms and looked at Huang Yu meaningfully. He didn't say anything. Seeing this, Huang Yu's heart kept sinking. He felt that this credit was going to be lost.

Unexpectedly, Han Xiao turned around and picked up a stack of documents. He threw it into his arms and said, "These are the construction progress of the sanctuary. Help me organize it and report to me if there's anything."

Huang Yu held the documents and immediately stood up. "Don't worry, I will handle it well."

"Go." Han Xiao waved his hand and went back to work in front of the lathe.

The excited Huang Yu walked out of the house and let out a sigh of relief. Black Phantom naturally understood the potential of Sanctuary Three, but he didn't care about the past and was willing to let him join in to share the credit. This made him very grateful.

Compared to his previous perfunctory attitude, Huang Yu couldn't help but feel ashamed. He was obedient to Han Xiao in his heart.

…

Han Xiao had thought it through very clearly. There was no need to make a bad assistant. The small differences between them couldn't even be considered a conflict. Seeing that Huang Yu had lowered his head, Han Xiao wouldn't purposely destroy his future. Furthermore, he did need an assistant to take care of the construction of the sanctuary. This kind of thing was very complicated, and it was giving him a headache.

Now, he had completely become a hands-off manager and could do his own things 24/7.

It had only been three days since the construction started, but the progress was like a wild dog that was out of control. The effort of the players still exceeded Han Technician's expectations. Even the migrant workers were not as hardworking as them. They were all model workers.

In the original timeline, when the players came in contact with the main storyline of the sanctuary, it was already past the earliest stage. It was the Dark Net who took the initiative to hire the players. At that time, a few sanctuaries were being built at the same time. The players had different choices, so the number of people was spread out.

Now, the players also found out that Han Xiao was in Sanctuary Three, so there were definitely other sanctuaries that needed to be built. However, there were very few channels for information, so they knew nothing about Sanctuary One and Sanctuary Two. On the other hand, the famous' Black Phantom 'in Sanctuary Three knew what to choose at first glance.

Most people had a herd effect. As the number of players in Sanctuary Three increased, it attracted other players as well. The number of people snowballed. Han Xiao's' Player Main City 'plan had great prospects.

Sanctuary Three was full of people. All kinds of hawking, setting up stalls, and asking to team up could be heard. The players spontaneously formed many markets and areas. Where to sell things, where to PK. The bustling scene did have some characteristics of a 'main city'.

Even the players from the Six Nations had abandoned the expedition gathering and came here to build a city.

The expedition mission had a level requirement, and since it had not started yet, some players chose the easier sanctuaries.

Han Xiao felt a sense of accomplishment as if he could raise his arms and call for help.

Looks like my image building plan is very successful. Han Xiao was very satisfied with the players' reaction. He also paid attention to the reaction of the forums and the Dark Net.

The incident in Sanctuary Three not only affected the players, but also in the eyes of the Blue Star organizations, it was another shocking scene.

The issue of Inhumans had always been highly concerned. When the Six Nations found out that Inhumans were gathering in Southern Continent, they were confused after investigating the situation.

Why was Black Phantom so influential among the Inhumans? How could he command the Inhumans? What was the relationship between the two?

All the organizations were on high alert. The danger level of Black Phantom had increased to another level.

The Dark Net was the first to receive the news. Bennett was also shocked by the scale of the situation. He remembered that Han Xiao had said that he would surpass Sanctuary One's progress in a month. It turned out that he was not joking.

Looking at the progress, there was a real possibility of success.

Bennett was not shocked but happy. As long as the sanctuary could be built, it did not matter who came first. They had all contributed. He did not doubt the people he used, so he would not ask how Han Xiao got the help of the Inhumans.

However, the Dark Net executives felt a chill down their backs. They did not know if it was a blessing or a curse to have such a strong colleague.

…

West of Sanctuary Three, Clock Tower District.

The landmark of this area was a huge clock tower covered in vines. At this time, it had already become the players' stronghold. Nearby was a huge square. There was a dried-up river that separated the southeast and the bridge was broken. A little further away was a cluster of low factory buildings. This place was originally a mixture of residential and industrial areas.

Around the clock tower, the prototype of a factory had been built. There were a lot of building materials and generators inside. The terrain was open, so it was suitable to build a power station to provide energy for the sanctuary.

There were hundreds of players cleaning the ruins and chasing away the beasts.

A team of five players was trekking in the drainage pipe of the river. It was pitch black, and only the light from the flashlights could be seen.

"It smells a bit bad here." A player covered his nose.

"They said that they want to set up a power grid, so they need people to check the situation in the drainage pipe to see if there is any danger," another person said.

"No wonder no one wants to do this mission. It's too dirty …" A person seemed to be obsessed with cleanliness and walked carefully.

After a few decades, the drainage pipe was still damp. There was a clear adsorption feeling on the ground, as if the damp and rotten soil had turned into a sticky foreign substance.

The team of players walked a few steps forward. Suddenly, they heard a gasp from the depths of the darkness. It sounded like a wind tunnel!

Hu —

"Something's wrong!"

The players were shocked. Just as they were about to move, they realized that they could not move. A notification appeared on the interface.

You have been affected by the Advanced Beast Intimidation Aura. You have entered the Fear state!

"What is this?" Their faces changed.

Rumble —

The ground shook violently. A black shadow that filled the entire tunnel rushed toward them like a wall.

With a bang, the team of players flew in all directions as if they were hit by a train. They slammed into the walls of the tunnel and died instantly. Although they were not the first batch of players, they were still people who had reached LV 15. Just one hit was enough to send them back to life. The damage was at least 200 to 300!

The black shadow was not alone. Behind it, there was a series of black shadows of the same size. After killing the intruders, they did not stop. They rushed out of the tunnel directly and exposed themselves to the sun. Like angry tanks, they rushed onto the ground and went straight for the most eye-catching tower clock.

The players who were resting at the tower clock saw the sudden change. They all stood up to intercept the black shadows. However, those who blocked the way were all killed by the black shadows and sent flying.

Like a hot knife through butter, no one could stop them!

A large group of black shadows ran over the players and crashed into the power plant that was under construction. With a boom, there was an explosion. The black shadows did not stop and crashed into the tower clock.

The ground trembled!

The tower clock spurted out a large amount of dust and made a tearing sound. It was like the cry of a dying person in despair. It collapsed with a boom.

The commotion here had shocked the entire city!

Loud and ferocious beastly roars also came from the mouths of the black shadows, shaking the sky!
